old_entry.expected_answer: Activate crafting pieces matching icons; each piece once per turn. Card suit is not its crafting cost. Immediate effect resolves then card discarded; item must be in supply or cannot craft. Persistent effect stays in play area; cannot craft identical effect already there. Vagabond uses hammers and can reactivate pawn.

new_entry.expected_answer: Activate crafting pieces matching every crafting icon; each piece may normally activate only once per turn. A crafting piece's suit is its clearing's suit, and the card's own suit is not its crafting cost. An item must be available in the map supply or that card cannot be crafted. Resolve an immediate effect and discard the card; a persistent effect stays in the play area, and an identical persistent effect already there prevents crafting another. For Vagabond crafting, exhaust one face-up, undamaged hammer per crafting icon; the pawn may be activated repeatedly, but its clearing must match every crafting icon. Reusing the pawn does not waive the hammer payment for each icon.

corrections.reason: Broad crafting-cost request includes one ready undamaged Vagabond hammer per icon; old key did not unambiguously require that payment.
